## Libraries

```{r setup, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(rpart.plot)

root_dir <- if (dir.exists("TA_functions")) "." else if (dir.exists("../TA_functions")) ".." else "../.."
simulation_dir <- if (dir.exists("Simulation_Scenario_B")) "Simulation_Scenario_B" else ".."
results_dir <- file.path(simulation_dir, "results")
image_dir <- file.path(simulation_dir, "images", "sensitivity")
dir.create(results_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(image_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

source(file.path(root_dir, "TA_functions", "TA_functions.R"), local = TRUE)
source(file.path(root_dir, "TA_functions", "Rephrase_Rule_Func.R"), local = TRUE)
source(file.path(simulation_dir, "code", "generate_actual_and_forecasts_data.R"))
```

## Configuration

```{r configuration}
# auto.arima() is deterministic. The replication seed changes the simulated
# innovations and Lunar New Year shock magnitudes before ARIMA is fitted.
seed_override <- Sys.getenv("SCENARIO_B_REPLICATION_SEEDS", unset = "")
replication_seeds <- if (nzchar(seed_override)) {
  as.integer(strsplit(seed_override, ",", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
} else {
  1001:1100
}
n_groups <- 20
n_rules <- 4
lift_metric <- "rmse"
analysis_id <- "no_iso_week_depth_7"
tree_formula <- .resid ~ Day + WeekofMonth + Month

param_grid <- expand.grid(
  cp = c(0, 0.00001, 0.0001, 0.0005),
  minbucket = seq(4, 8, by = 1),
  maxdepth = seq(1, 7, by = 1)
)
```

## Replication Function

```{r replication-function}
run_replication <- function(seed) {
  analysis_data <- generate_actual_and_forecasts_data(
    seed = seed,
    write_output = FALSE
  )
  train_set <- analysis_data %>% filter(Time <= as.Date("2021-12-31"))
  test_set <- analysis_data %>% filter(Time >= as.Date("2022-01-01"))

  grid_search <- tree_alert_grid_search(
    train_set = train_set,
    formula = tree_formula,
    param_grid = param_grid,
    n_groups = n_groups,
    pred_col_name = "Tree_Prediction",
    lift_metric = lift_metric
  )
  best_params <- grid_search$best_params
  tree_model <- tree_alert_train_best_model(
    train_set = train_set,
    formula = tree_formula,
    best_params = best_params
  )

  train_set$Tree_Prediction <- as.numeric(predict(tree_model, newdata = train_set, type = "vector"))
  test_set$Tree_Prediction <- as.numeric(predict(tree_model, newdata = test_set, type = "vector"))
  train_lift <- tree_alert_compute_lift_numeric(
    train_set, ".resid", "Tree_Prediction", n_groups, lift_metric
  )
  test_lift <- tree_alert_compute_lift_numeric(
    test_set, ".resid", "Tree_Prediction", n_groups, lift_metric
  )

  tree_rules <- rpart.plot::rpart.rules(tree_model, cover = FALSE, digits = 4, nn = FALSE)
  rule_selection <- tree_alert_pull_top_k_rules(tree_rules, n_rules = n_rules)
  raw_rules <- vapply(
    seq_len(nrow(rule_selection$selected_rules)),
    function(i) tree_alert_format_rule_raw(rule_selection$selected_rules[i, ]),
    character(1)
  )

  replication_results <- tibble(
    seed = seed,
    cp = best_params$cp,
    minbucket = best_params$minbucket,
    maxdepth = best_params$maxdepth,
    terminal_nodes = length(unique(train_set$Tree_Prediction)),
    train_first_ventile_lift = train_lift,
    test_first_ventile_lift = test_lift
  )
  grid_results <- grid_search$results %>% mutate(seed = seed, .before = 1)
  rules_results <- tibble(
    seed = seed,
    rule_rank = seq_along(raw_rules),
    raw_rule = raw_rules,
    interpretation = vapply(raw_rules, rephrase_rule, character(1), minute_increment = NULL)
  )

  list(
    replication_results = replication_results,
    grid_results = grid_results,
    rules_results = rules_results
  )
}
```

## Run Replications

```{r run-replications, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
merge_replication_csv <- function(new_data, path, key_columns) {
  existing_data <- if (file.exists(path)) {
    read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  } else {
    new_data[0, ]
  }

  bind_rows(new_data, existing_data) %>%
    distinct(across(all_of(key_columns)), .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    arrange(across(all_of(key_columns)))
}

replication_output <- lapply(replication_seeds, run_replication)

replication_results <- merge_replication_csv(
  bind_rows(lapply(replication_output, `[[`, "replication_results")),
  file.path(results_dir, paste0("scenario_b_", analysis_id, "_replication_results.csv")),
  "seed"
)
grid_results <- merge_replication_csv(
  bind_rows(lapply(replication_output, `[[`, "grid_results")),
  file.path(results_dir, paste0("scenario_b_", analysis_id, "_replication_grid_search.csv")),
  c("seed", "cp", "minbucket", "maxdepth")
)
rules_results <- merge_replication_csv(
  bind_rows(lapply(replication_output, `[[`, "rules_results")),
  file.path(results_dir, paste0("scenario_b_", analysis_id, "_replication_rules.csv")),
  c("seed", "rule_rank")
)

write_csv(
  replication_results,
  file.path(results_dir, paste0("scenario_b_", analysis_id, "_replication_results.csv"))
)
write_csv(
  grid_results,
  file.path(results_dir, paste0("scenario_b_", analysis_id, "_replication_grid_search.csv"))
)
write_csv(
  rules_results,
  file.path(results_dir, paste0("scenario_b_", analysis_id, "_replication_rules.csv"))
)
```

## Lift Summary

```{r lift-summary}
lift_summary <- replication_results %>%
  summarise(
    replications = n(),
    train_min = min(train_first_ventile_lift),
    train_q25 = quantile(train_first_ventile_lift, 0.25),
    train_median = median(train_first_ventile_lift),
    train_q75 = quantile(train_first_ventile_lift, 0.75),
    train_max = max(train_first_ventile_lift),
    test_min = min(test_first_ventile_lift),
    test_q25 = quantile(test_first_ventile_lift, 0.25),
    test_median = median(test_first_ventile_lift),
    test_q75 = quantile(test_first_ventile_lift, 0.75),
    test_max = max(test_first_ventile_lift),
    test_lift_above_one_pct = mean(test_first_ventile_lift > 1) * 100
  )

write_csv(
  lift_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, paste0("scenario_b_", analysis_id, "_replication_lift_summary.csv"))
)

lift_summary
```

## Lift Distribution

```{r lift-boxplot}
lift_long <- replication_results %>%
  select(seed, train_first_ventile_lift, test_first_ventile_lift) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -seed,
    names_to = "evaluation_set",
    values_to = "lift"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    evaluation_set = recode(
      evaluation_set,
      train_first_ventile_lift = "Training",
      test_first_ventile_lift = "Test"
    ),
    evaluation_set = factor(evaluation_set, levels = c("Training", "Test"))
  )

one_sided_boxplot_stats <- function(data, group_vars) {
  data %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_vars))) %>%
    summarise(
      ymin = quantile(lift, 0.05),
      lower = quantile(lift, 0.25),
      middle = median(lift),
      upper = quantile(lift, 0.75),
      ymax = quantile(lift, 0.75),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

one_sided_lower_tail <- function(data, group_vars) {
  data %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_vars))) %>%
    filter(lift < quantile(lift, 0.05)) %>%
    ungroup()
}

replication_lift_stats <- one_sided_boxplot_stats(lift_long, "evaluation_set")
replication_lift_lower_tail <- one_sided_lower_tail(lift_long, "evaluation_set")

replication_lift_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "solid", color = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_boxplot(
    data = replication_lift_stats,
    aes(
      x = evaluation_set, ymin = ymin, lower = lower, middle = middle,
      upper = upper, ymax = ymax, fill = evaluation_set, group = evaluation_set
    ),
    stat = "identity", width = 0.55, color = "#333333"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = replication_lift_lower_tail,
    aes(x = evaluation_set, y = lift),
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.07, height = 0),
    size = 1.8, shape = 21, fill = "white", color = "#333333"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Training" = "#4C78A8", "Test" = "#E17C05")) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 6)) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "First-ventile lift") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18, face = "plain"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, face = "plain")
  )

replication_lift_plot

ggsave(
  file.path(image_dir, paste0("scenario_b_", analysis_id, "_replication_lift_sensitivity.png")),
  plot = replication_lift_plot,
  width = 9,
  height = 3.3,
  dpi = 1000
)
```

## Selected Hyperparameter Sensitivity

```{r selected-hyperparameter-sensitivity}
format_parameter_setting <- function(setting, hyperparameter) {
  if (hyperparameter == "Complexity parameter") {
    formatC(setting, format = "f", digits = 5, drop0trailing = TRUE)
  } else {
    as.character(as.integer(setting))
  }
}

selected_parameter_lift <- replication_results %>%
  select(seed, cp, minbucket, maxdepth, train_first_ventile_lift, test_first_ventile_lift) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(train_first_ventile_lift, test_first_ventile_lift),
    names_to = "evaluation_set",
    values_to = "lift"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    evaluation_set = recode(
      evaluation_set,
      train_first_ventile_lift = "Training",
      test_first_ventile_lift = "Test"
    ),
    evaluation_set = factor(evaluation_set, levels = c("Training", "Test"))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(cp, minbucket, maxdepth),
    names_to = "hyperparameter",
    values_to = "setting"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    hyperparameter = recode(
      hyperparameter,
      cp = "Complexity parameter",
      minbucket = "Minimum bucket",
      maxdepth = "Maximum depth"
    ),
    setting_label = mapply(format_parameter_setting, setting, hyperparameter),
    setting_label = factor(setting_label, levels = unique(setting_label[order(setting)])),
    hyperparameter = factor(
      hyperparameter,
      levels = c("Complexity parameter", "Minimum bucket", "Maximum depth")
    )
  )

selected_parameter_stats <- one_sided_boxplot_stats(
  selected_parameter_lift,
  c("hyperparameter", "setting_label", "evaluation_set")
)
selected_parameter_lower_tail <- one_sided_lower_tail(
  selected_parameter_lift,
  c("hyperparameter", "setting_label", "evaluation_set")
)

selected_parameter_plot <- ggplot(
  selected_parameter_stats,
  aes(
    x = setting_label, fill = evaluation_set,
    group = interaction(setting_label, evaluation_set)
  )
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "solid", color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(ymin = ymin, lower = lower, middle = middle, upper = upper, ymax = ymax),
    stat = "identity",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    width = 0.65,
    color = "#333333"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = selected_parameter_lower_tail,
    aes(
      x = setting_label, y = lift, fill = evaluation_set,
      group = interaction(setting_label, evaluation_set)
    ),
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.08, dodge.width = 0.75),
    size = 1.4, shape = 21, color = "#333333"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~hyperparameter, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Training" = "#4C78A8", "Test" = "#E17C05")) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 6)) +
  labs(x = "Hyperparameter value", y = "First-ventile lift", fill = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

selected_parameter_plot

ggsave(
  file.path(image_dir, paste0("scenario_b_", analysis_id, "_selected_parameter_lift.png")),
  plot = selected_parameter_plot,
  width = 11,
  height = 4.25,
  dpi = 1000
)
```
